question: What were outstanding case reserves at 31 December 2025?
final_text:
Outstanding case reserves at 31 December 2025 were £15,020,532.03. This is the year-end balance for 2025, gross of reinsurance. Case reserves are a point-in-time balance, so I took the closing position at the end of the year, not a sum over the year.

ANSWER: 15020532.03
